name: Strength Bobblehead
description: Hefted a turbine rotor alone the night the grid went dark. Grip first, questions later.

name: Perception Bobblehead
description: A lookout's award, left in the curator's desk. The one exhibit the raiders never found.

name: Endurance Bobblehead
description: Passed around the tarberry rows every harvest. The wasteland wears out; it didn't.

name: Charisma Bobblehead
description: The station's on-air trophy. The voice on the tape still says the line better than anyone alive.

name: Intelligence Bobblehead
description: A lab mascot from before the walls went up. Its notes are better than its smile.

name: Agility Bobblehead
description: A courier's charm, carried the length of the tunnel at a dead run and never dropped.

name: Luck Bobblehead
description: Pried out of a vending machine that paid out one time too many. The coin landed your way.
